listing.name: AstroMenace
listing.summary: Fly a customizable fighter through a 3D space shooter from Viewizard.
listing.download_block_reason: Portcove downloads are on hold until the contents of the Windows installer can be checked. You can use the upstream setup guide with a copy you have permission to use.

steps.title: Set up the Windows release
steps.instruction: Use the publisher’s v1.4.3 installer and open AstroMenace when setup completes. The installer includes the standalone game.

steps.title: Use your Linux package or build on Mac
steps.instruction: Install astromenace through your Linux distribution, or use the community Flatpak for x64 or ARM64 from the upstream guide. On Mac, follow the source-build instructions for the required Xcode and Homebrew tools.

references.title: Keep your pilots and settings
references.instruction: Preserve config.xml and the versioned PilotProfiles_*.data file in the active profile. Windows and Mac use the Viewizard/AstroMenace user folder. On native Linux keep astromenace under XDG_CONFIG_HOME or ~/.config. If you use Flatpak, keep its separate app profile.
